title.en: China AI Companion Regulation Forces Doubao and Qwen to Shut Down Agent Functions
title.zhHans: 中国 AI 伴侣法规迫使豆包和通义千问下线智能体功能

searchSummary.en: New Chinese AI companion regulations forced ByteDance's Doubao (345M users) and Alibaba's Qwen to disable their humanlike AI agent functions by July 15, 2026, targeting sustained emotional interaction services.
searchSummary.zhHans: 中国新的 AI 伴侣法规迫使字节跳动豆包（3.45 亿用户）和阿里巴巴通义千问在 2026 年 7 月 15 日前关闭其人形 AI 智能体功能，针对的是持续性情感交互服务。

summary.en: In early July 2026, new Chinese regulations targeting AI companion services forced major platforms to shut down their humanlike AI agent functions. ByteDance's Doubao (Doubao), China's largest AI companion app with over 345 million users, announced its agent functionality would go offline on July 15, 2026. Alibaba's Qwen similarly disabled its humanlike and user-created agents on July 10. The regulations specifically target bots offering 'sustained emotional interaction' while sparing workplace and productivity agents. Users can still view their agent configurations and conversation histories in read-only mode until October 15, 2026. The rule represents one of the most direct government interventions into the AI companion market globally.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月初，针对 AI 伴侣服务的新中国法规迫使主要平台关闭其人形 AI 智能体功能。字节跳动的豆包——中国最大的 AI 伴侣应用，拥有超过 3.45 亿用户——宣布其智能体功能将于 2026 年 7 月 15 日下线。阿里巴巴的通义千问同样于 7 月 10 日禁用了其人形和用户创建的智能体。这些规定专门针对提供'持续性情感交互'的机器人，同时豁免了工作场所和生产力的智能体。用户可以在 2026 年 10 月 15 日前以只读模式查看其智能体配置和对话历史。该规定是全球范围内对 AI 伴侣市场最直接的政府干预之一。

narrative.en: China's AI companion market had exploded in 2025-2026, led by ByteDance's Doubao — a chatbot designed for emotional companionship, casual conversation, and roleplay. Doubao amassed over 345 million users, making it one of the most widely used AI products in the world by user count. Alibaba's Qwen offered similar humanlike agent capabilities. In early July 2026, Chinese regulators enacted new rules targeting 'sustained emotional interaction' AI services. The rules are part of a broader regulatory push that also covers deep synthesis (deepfake) content and recommendation algorithms. Key provisions: AI agents designed for emotional companionship must be disabled; workplace and productivity agents are exempt; user data (agent configurations, conversation histories) will be preserved in read-only mode for three months after shutdown. The economic impact is substantial: Doubao and Qwen had built significant user bases and revenue streams around their companion AI offerings. The regulatory action signals Beijing's willingness to sharply restrict AI applications that it deems socially risky, even when those applications have achieved massive adoption.
narrative.zhHans: 中国的 AI 伴侣市场在 2025-2026 年爆发式增长，以字节跳动的豆包为首——一个专为情感陪伴、休闲聊天和角色扮演设计的聊天机器人。豆包积累了超过 3.45 亿用户，按用户数量计算是世界上最广泛使用的 AI 产品之一。阿里巴巴的通义千问提供类似的人形智能体功能。2026年7月初，中国监管机构颁布了新规，针对'持续性情感交互'AI 服务。这些规定是更广泛的监管推动的一部分，也涵盖深度合成内容和推荐算法。关键条款：为情感陪伴设计的 AI 智能体必须关闭；工作场所和生产力智能体获豁免；用户数据（智能体配置、对话历史）将在关闭后以只读模式保留三个月。经济影响巨大：豆包和通义千问围绕其伴侣 AI 服务建立了庞大的用户群和收入流。该监管行动表明北京愿意严格限制其认为具有社会风险的 AI 应用，即使这些应用已获得大规模普及。

description.en: Doubao (345M users) and Qwen forced to shut down core AI companion features. Significant impact on user base, revenue models, and the broader Chinese AI companion industry estimated at tens of billions of RMB.
description.zhHans: 豆包（3.45 亿用户）和通义千问被迫关闭核心 AI 伴侣功能。对用户群、收入模式和估计达数百亿人民币的更广泛中国 AI 伴侣行业产生重大影响。

description.en: First major government-mandated shutdown of widely adopted AI companion services globally. Sets a precedent for how governments may intervene in the AI companion market, which has grown rapidly worldwide.
description.zhHans: 全球首个政府强制关闭大规模普及的 AI 伴侣服务。为各国政府如何干预在全球快速增长的 AI 伴侣市场设立了先例。

description.en: 345 million users lose access to AI companion services they had incorporated into daily life. Raises questions about user dependence on AI emotional support and the social impact of sudden withdrawal.
description.zhHans: 3.45 亿用户失去了他们已融入日常生活的 AI 伴侣服务。这引发了关于用户对 AI 情感支持的依赖以及突然退出带来的社会影响的问题。

text.en: ByteDance's Doubao (345M+ users) disabled its agent functionality on July 15, 2026, and Alibaba's Qwen disabled humanlike agents on July 10, due to new Chinese regulations targeting sustained emotional interaction AI services.
text.zhHans: 字节跳动的豆包（3.45 亿+用户）于 2026 年 7 月 15 日下线其智能体功能，阿里巴巴的通义千问于 7 月 10 日禁用人形智能体，原因是针对持续性情感交互 AI 服务的新中国法规。

text.en: Workplace and productivity AI agents are exempt from the regulation. Users can view their data in read-only mode until October 15, 2026.
text.zhHans: 工作场所和生产力 AI 智能体不受该法规限制。用户可在 2026 年 10 月 15 日前以只读模式查看其数据。

text.en: The regulation represents a major government intervention in the AI companion market, reflecting Beijing's willingness to restrict socially risky AI applications regardless of their adoption scale.
text.zhHans: 该规定代表了政府对 AI 伴侣市场的重大干预，反映了北京限制具有社会风险的 AI 应用的意愿，无论其普及规模如何。

text.en: Doubao (345M users) and Qwen forced to shut down core AI companion features. Significant impact on user base, revenue models, and the broader Chinese AI companion industry estimated at tens of billions of RMB.
text.zhHans: 豆包（3.45 亿用户）和通义千问被迫关闭核心 AI 伴侣功能。对用户群、收入模式和估计达数百亿人民币的更广泛中国 AI 伴侣行业产生重大影响。
